historical_reuse.purpose: Scoped reuse review of five historical passing Source/type stages after CLI test resource-budget changes; not a rerun and not acceptance of the current full suite.
limits: The entire historical freeze is not unchanged: both README files and three CLI test files differ or are newly added.
The two base-image artifacts are newly included in freeze scope; no old artifact equality is asserted.
Historical budgets and invocation profiles are preserved as recorded; this is not five new runs under the progress runner.
Compiler-based type results remain limited to their recorded Darwin/CGO/toolchain profile; this check does not compile or certify another platform, foreign library update, or toolchain change.
Python interpreter/installed dependency files outside the frozen repository scope are not rehashed by this check.
Current ordinary Go/vet/race/coverage/Python/invariant/scan/consumer results must be evaluated separately; historical Source/type reuse does not establish their success.
The active full-Go stage still must verify its end-of-stage freeze; this receipt is a read-time comparison.

coverage.method: Stream one complete passing atomic profile; identical spans count once, covered if any duplicate has hits. All includes tools; app excludes /tools/ and includes CLI; provider is /provider/ only.
coverage.scope: Go statements only; excludes Python, native C, subprocess interiors, branches, other platforms and migration acceptance.

limitations: This script runs no tests, builds, audits or host monitoring.
A failed consumer inventory remains failed and does not suppress unrelated stage evidence.
Resource observations are sampled and cleanup only confirms observed process identities.
